summary: Cancelled plan to remove navigation beacon MAC; MAC to be reinstated, serving EGEC.
text:
THE CHANGES TO REMOVE DME MAC AND INTRODUCE DME CAL IMPLEMENTED IN
AIRAC 12/2026 WEF 26 NOVEMBER 2026 HAVE BEEN CANCELLED.
FROM AIRAC 12/2026 WEF 26 NOVEMBER 2026 PLEASE AMEND THE FOLLOWING:
RADIO NAVIGATION AND LANDING AIDS - REMOVE DME CAL REFERENCE.
DME MAC TO BE REINTRODUCED:
TYPE - DME
IDENT - MAC
CH/FREQ - 107X/116.000MHZ
HOURS OF OP - H24
POSITION - 552548.08N 0053901.49W
DME ELEV - 122FT
REMARKS - NO ASSOCIATED EN-ROUTE VOR. DME DOC 150 NM/50000 FT (200
NM/50000 FT IN SECTOR R227-347). DUE TO TERRAIN, COVERAGE AT LOW
LEVEL IS REDUCED IN SECTORS R122-162, R207-237 AND R347-082.
UK AIP GEN 2.5, EGEC AD 2.19 AND DIGITAL DATASET REFERS.
